facts.fact: Blair 拔了电水壶电源、抡圆了像打板球——哐一声砸中他后脑，血流进衣领。
facts.anchor: I swing like a cricketer playing for my life, and it connects with the back of his skull with a crunch.

facts.fact: 刀落地的瞬间被 Blair 一脚踢向 Nova。
facts.anchor: I kick it in Nova’s direction before he has a chance to collect it again.

facts.fact: Nova 把 Blair 推开、将刀捅进 George 的肩膀。
facts.anchor: only this time shoving me out of the way and plunging the knife into George’s shoulder.

facts.fact: 卧室筑障：两人合力把五斗柜顶上门——她开窗、 Blair 抱着 Luna 的航空箱先翻出窗。
facts.anchor: until we’ve manoeuvred it in front of the bedroom door.

facts.fact: 拳头砸门：我要杀了你们——两个都杀。
facts.anchor: ‘I’m going to fucking kill you.’ His fist continues to pound the other side of the door relentlessly as he yells. ‘BOTH of you.’

facts.fact: 共犯结构成立：他若报警，两个女人一起背「谋杀未遂」。
facts.anchor: because we’re well and truly in this together now.

facts.fact: 逃亡路上交出真名：Cassie Torrance——Nova「并不存在，大概吧，只在我脑子里」。
facts.anchor: ‘My real name is Cassie. Cassie Torrance. Nova is…well, she doesn’t exist, I suppose. Not really. Just in my head, I guess.’

facts.fact: Blair 脱下皮衣裹住瑟抖的她，挽起胳膊：「走吧，Cassie——我知道你要带我们去哪。」
facts.anchor: I shrug off my leather jacket, wrap it around her shoulders and link my arm with hers.
